title: A 30-second scroll break: calm breathing to do before you keep scrolling.

copy.instagram_caption:
A 30-second scroll break: calm breathing to do before you keep scrolling.

In through your nose for 4. Out slowly for 6. Three rounds. The long exhale does the work.

This is Scroll break 01. A new one every week. Save it and come back whenever the feed has you wired.

DeRot is coming soon to iPhone. It brings a break like this into the apps that wind you up. Launch list: link in bio.
